test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

The update

P. ensuring security

Q. enhanced encryption

R. and data autonomy

S. across user devices
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence needs to be rearranged to form a coherent and logical statement.
 
• The correct sequence is **QRPS**, which forms the sentence: *"The update enhanced encryption, ensuring security and data autonomy across user devices."*
 
• Option 2 (QRPS) maintains the logical flow of the sentence: starting with the update's key feature (enhanced encryption), followed by its purpose (ensuring security), and then elaborating on the additional benefits (data autonomy across user devices).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Rearranged Sentence:** *"The update enhanced encryption, ensuring security and data autonomy across user devices."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **P: "ensuring security"** – This part of the sentence indicates the purpose of the update.
 
• **Q: "enhanced encryption"** – This part highlights the primary feature of the update, and thus it should come first after the subject "The update."
 
• **R: "and data autonomy"** – This part adds more details about the benefits of the update.
 
• **S: "across user devices"** – This part specifies where the benefits apply, making it the logical conclusion of the sentence.
